title: Irrelevant marginal replacement
statement: Let $D$ be a finite set, let a constraint template on $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $c$ be one of its constraints on a set of variables. Suppose a variable $v$ does not occur in the scope of $c$. For any family of probability distributions on $D$ indexed by the variables and any label $a\in D$, replacing the distribution at $v$ by the point mass at $a$ leaves the expected satisfaction indicator of $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given
$c$ is a constraint for that template
A family of probability distributions on $D$ is given
A variable $v$ is outside the range of the constraint scope
